resources.name: Orion Network Telescope
quotes: To obtain a diverse set of vantage points, we use existing honeypots from GreyNoise, deploy our own honeypots, and use the Orion Network Telescope.

resources.name: Censys Universal Internet Dataset
quotes: IP addresses that previously hosted services that were indexed by Shodan [69] or Censys [32] attract a significantly different set of scanners
we investigate how attackers use the most-frequently scanning Internet service search engines [53]—Censys [32] and Shodan [69]—to find services.
references: [32] Z. Durumeric, D. Adrian, A. Mirian, M. Bailey, and J. A. Halderman. A search engine backed by Internet-wide scanning. In CCS, 2015.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors use Censys to identify IP addresses that previously hosted indexed services and to conduct experiments on the impact of leaking services to search engines.
